name: EPIC 212175185
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 16, 9.8 solar radii and 1.15 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212175185 (K2 campaign 16): PARAM radius (solar radii) 9.77805 (16th-84th percentiles 9.373372-10.207642), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 3,403 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 16, give 1.15 solar masses and 9.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,849 K at its surface.
